product_overview: LeetTracker Pro is an enterprise-grade LeetCode company-wise preparation platform that helps software engineers discover high-priority interview questions, review multi-approach solutions, and track preparation progress. It also supports authenticated user accounts, subscription billing, and supporting services like transactional email and health monitoring.
core_goals: Enable company-wise question discovery with filtering, search, and overlap analysis
Provide detailed problem metadata and multi-approach solution guidance
Support secure user registration, login, token refresh, and profile retrieval
Track solved problems, personal notes, tags, and preparation statistics
Offer subscription plans and Stripe checkout for paid access
Provide transactional email dispatch and audit visibility
Expose a health endpoint for service and database readiness monitoring

features.name: System Health and Monitoring API
features.description: Allows operational checks to confirm the API server and database are reachable.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with health status showing server and database connectivity
GET /api/health -> Receive non-200 or degraded health status when the database is unavailable

features.name: Questions and Solutions Catalog API
features.description: Lets users browse companies, search and filter questions, inspect question details, and view multi-approach solutions.
user_flows: GET /api/companies -> Receive 200 with company frequency counts -> GET /api/questions?company=Google&difficulty=Medium&tag=Arrays&keyword=two sum -> Receive 200 with paginated filtered questions -> GET /api/questions/:id -> Receive 200 with question metadata and company breakdown -> GET /api/questions/:id/solution -> Receive 200 with multi-approach C++ solution details
GET /api/questions?company=UnknownCompany -> Receive 200 with an empty result set or no matching questions
GET /api/questions/:id -> Receive 404 or equivalent error when the question ID does not exist
GET /api/companies/overlap -> Receive 200 with cross-company overlap results for selected companies

features.name: User Authentication and JWT Management API
features.description: Handles account registration, credential login, token refresh, logout, and authenticated profile retrieval.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with email, username, and password -> Receive 201 with account creation success -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access token and HTTP-only refresh cookie -> GET /api/auth/me with token -> Receive 200 with user profile and membership tier
POST /api/auth/register with invalid or missing fields -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/auth/login with invalid password -> Receive 401 invalid credentials
POST /api/auth/refresh with expired or missing refresh cookie -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/auth/logout -> Receive 200 with session termination and cleared refresh cookie

features.name: User Progress and Notes Tracking API
features.description: Stores solved status, personal notes, tags, whiteboard data, and aggregated preparation statistics for authenticated users.
user_flows: GET /api/progress with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with solved question map and personal notes -> PUT /api/progress/:questionId with status, notes, tags, and whiteboardData -> Receive 200 with updated progress record -> GET /api/progress/stats -> Receive 200 with aggregate preparation statistics
GET /api/progress without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
PUT /api/progress/:questionId with invalid questionId or malformed body -> Receive error response indicating update failure

features.name: Stripe Payment and Subscription Gateway API
features.description: Provides subscription plan discovery, checkout session creation, and subscription status lookup for authenticated users.
user_flows: GET /api/payments/plans -> Receive 200 with available subscription tiers and pricing -> POST /api/payments/create-checkout-session with a valid planId and auth token -> Receive 200 with Stripe checkout session or sandbox redirect URL -> GET /api/payments/status -> Receive 200 with current subscription tier and status
POST /api/payments/create-checkout-session with invalid planId -> Receive error response indicating plan validation failure
GET /api/payments/status without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Transactional Email Service API
features.description: Supports sending test or verification emails and reviewing the audit log of dispatched transactional messages.
user_flows: POST /api/email/test with recipient and type -> Receive 200 with email dispatch confirmation -> GET /api/email/logs with auth token -> Receive 200 with transactional email audit entries
POST /api/email/test with malformed recipient address -> Receive error response indicating dispatch failure
GET /api/email/logs without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
